issues.jp_before: 母[はは]は毎朝[まいあさ]、ビタミンの薬[くすり]を{飲[の]んでいます|cl-take}。
issues.problem: ビタミンの薬 is unnatural (ビタミン剤 is the normal word); English 'vitamin pill' did not match.
issues.action: Rewrote as 血圧[けつあつ]の薬 'blood pressure medicine'; lv 5 -> 3 for 血圧.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]、友達[ともだち]に電話[でんわ]を{かけたい|cl-take}です。
issues.problem: English 'tonight' does not translate 夜 (that would be 今夜).
issues.action: English changed to 'I want to call my friend in the evening.'

issues.jp_before: 汗[あせ]をかいたから、シャワーを{浴[あ]びて|cl-take}から寝[ね]ます。
issues.problem: Two から in a row (reason から + 浴びてから) is clumsy; English 'I've been sweating' slightly off.
issues.action: Changed reason から to ので; English 'I got sweaty, so ...'.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]は高校[こうこう]の試験[しけん]を{受[う]けた|cl-take}。
issues.problem: 高校の試験 means 'a high-school exam', not 'the high school entrance exam' as the English says.
issues.action: Changed to 高校[こうこう]の入試[にゅうし]を (avoids duplicating line 44's 入学試験); why updated.
